rootCause: HLS/DASH analyzer returned empty variants for adaptive streams instead of using yt-dlp metadata.
Metadata parser discarded HLS variants when yt-dlp omitted vcodec/acodec fields.
DASH audio-only formats were not represented canonically.
Video selectors used height<= fallbacks that could silently downgrade selected quality.
fixes: Adaptive HLS/DASH now goes through yt-dlp metadata analysis.
Parser preserves height-bearing HLS variants with implicit codecs.
Parser exposes audioFormats and analyzer exposes bestVideo, bestAudio, muxRequired and sourceType.
Selectors use bestvideo* and exact height=N semantics.
Audio quality UI and command builder distinguish best/high/standard/light; best MP3 maps to VBR 0.
